metadata.scenario: A returning customer notices a billing error where they have been billed twice for the same service and requests rectification. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Mark Johnson. I'm calling about a billing issue I've noticed. I'm sorry to hear that, Mark. Can you please provide me with more details? Yes, I was billed twice for the same medication management service last month. I understand. That must be frustrating. Let me pull up your account. Can you please confirm your address for me? Sure, it's 2847 North Ridge Road, Suite 205, Wichita, KS 67205. Thank you, Mark. One moment while I check your records. Okay, I see your account here. It looks like there was an error in our billing system that caused the duplicate charge. I apologize for that oversight. Thank you for looking into it. What steps can we take to rectify this? I will initiate a refund for the duplicate charge right away, and you should see that reflected in your account within 5-7 business days. That sounds good. Thank you for taking care of that. You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with today? Actually, yes. I have some elderly parents who need ongoing help. We can certainly assist with that. What specific services are you interested in? They need help with medication management and transportation to appointments. We offer both those services. Medication management is priced at $65-$80 per visit. That's reasonable. What about transportation? Transportation services range from $45 to $65 per trip, depending on the distance. Great. Can we schedule a consultation to discuss a care plan? Absolutely! I can connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen. She can assist with developing a care plan tailored to your parents’ needs. That would be perfect. How do I reach her? You can reach Lisa at +13165559203, or I can connect you directly now. Let's do that. I’d like to speak with her right away. Sure! One moment while I transfer the call to Lisa. Thank you, Margaret. You're welcome! Transferring you now.
